answer: Deposits are visible in inlet, and haven reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 144 aliases, and each one needs its own funded summit account. A bond of 31% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 156 aliases cost 75 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
